Cricket selectors debate potential return of bowlers Shami and Bhuvneshwar

Former chief selector MSK Prasad has advocated for the potential return of fast bowlers Mohammed Shami and Bhuvneshwar Kumar to the Indian cricket team. Prasad's comments follow Bhuvneshwar Kumar's recent recall to the squad, suggesting a broader consideration of experienced bowlers for upcoming matches.
